text.en:
House Moving Prices from Ankara to Liverpool

Moving from Ankara to Liverpool is not just a physical location change, but a beginning of a new life. With our house moving prices from Ankara to Liverpool service, we make this transition process the most comfortable for you.

House Moving Service Details

Technical details are at the forefront of our complete home moving focused service. Planning is made based on volume calculation (m3). Disassembly of furniture and assembly in the UK are included in the price. 3-layer protection is provided with bubble wrap, kraft paper, and special furniture blankets. You can also benefit from our door-to-door insured (All-Risk) full-service advantage.

2026 Pricing Policy

Prices for operations departing from Ankara are determined according to the volume (CBM), weight of the items, and the exact address to be reached. Toll fees and ferry crossing costs are reflected in the price for loads arriving in Liverpool. Please request a free survey for a net figure.

Our Logistics Process from Ankara to Liverpool

In the transports we carry out from Ankara, we use intermodal transport via Istanbul or direct road. The distance between the two points is approximately 3,450 km, and our estimated delivery time is 12-14 days. We offer special advantages to our customers with consolidated transport from our Central Anatolia Regional Collection Center and an expert team in public personnel and diplomatic goods transport.

Process Steps

  • Survey: Volume determination at your address in Ankara.
  • Operation: 3-layer protection is provided with bubble wrap, kraft paper, and special furniture blankets.
  • Customs: Export operations from Ankara and import operations to Liverpool.
  • Delivery: Scheduled delivery and installation support.

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the payment made?

A reservation is made with a 30% down payment, and the rest is collected upon delivery.

What does the insurance cover?

Our All-Risk insurance covers the risks of accident, fire, and theft in the process from the packaging of the items to the delivery.

Are there customs duties?

If you get ToR approval in the status of personal effects, you do not pay tax. Planning is made based on volume calculation (m3).

Conclusion and Contact

Choose Han Bros Cargo for house moving prices from Ankara to Liverpool. Call us now to meet our consolidated transport advantages from our Central Anatolia Regional Collection Center.
